data: What activation function is used in the feed-forward layers?

The question asks about the activation function used in the feed-forward layers. From the caption, it mentions that the figure is simplified and refers to Vaswani et al. (2017) for more details. In the figure, there are two feed-forward layers shown, one at the top and one at the bottom. The feed-forward layer at the top is labeled with "Feed Forward" and has a linear activation function, while the feed-forward layer at the bottom also has a linear activation function. Therefore, the activation function used in the feed-forward layers is linear.
